feat: wire camellia runtime config and release sync (#44)

## Summary
- switch camellia to a runtime environment contract backed by `CAMELLIA_API_BASE_URL` / `CAMELLIA_APP_CODE`
- inject the runtime config into the SSR shell, resolve API base URLs dynamically, and add a repeatable `smoke:camellia` route smoke
- update the staging and production release workflows so camellia image publishing also updates the garden GitOps target

## Testing
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea run check:camellia`
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea run smoke:camellia`
- `docker build -f bougainvillea/apps/camellia/Dockerfile bougainvillea`

## Notes
- Companion GitOps PR deploys the new `camellia-stg.iprtapp.com` / `camellia.iprtapp.com` frontend entries and runtime env values.
- Live menu and permission acceptance still requires an existing staging bearer token; unauthenticated `GET https://woodii-api-stg.iprtapp.com/api/v1/access/menus` returns `KICK_OUT`.
